observed: Python helper route on the real F32 OXR model produced the formula page (1 request, exact expected LaTeX); the C++ `test-oxr-document --replay` call then printed nothing and the harness crashed with JSONDecodeError on empty stdout.
cause: Harness bug, not a native regression. The Python helper route (python/crispembed/_oxr.py, since 3e694a95) records each trace entry with `max_new_tokens`, while the C++ replay (tests/test_oxr_document.cpp run_replay) and the native route's trace key on `max_tokens`. `need(t, "max_tokens")` throws while building the replay table, outside the replay's try block, so the process terminates with empty stdout; tools/oxr_doc_parity.py parsed stdout without checking the exit code.
fix: tools/oxr_doc_parity.py normalizes the Python trace to carry `max_tokens` (also needed by the live request-set comparison) and raises with the binary's exit code and stderr when a replay prints no JSON. No runtime, model or gate change.
next: Re-dispatch the same stages on main after the fix lands; record native/replay/live parity on all five cases.
